ns2:section.sectionText: In the Intermediate/Advancecd Ballroom you will learn the patterns and technique of the American Smooth waltz and tango. The emphasis will be placed on proper technique and application of basic principles of footwork, rise and fall, swing, sway, and contrary body movement. Everyone will be expected to dance both lead and follow roles. Prior knowledge of basic ballroom steps and techniques is a plus but not a requirement. Restricted to Dance majors. Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Dance or Dance or Dance and Kinesiology major(s).
